propositions: Negative caplog assertions pass vacuously when zero records are captured, failing open instead of failing closed, because empty lists satisfy 'assert not [...]' and zero-element iterables do not raise in negations

Logger propagation disabled process-globally via logging.getLogger('rebar').propagate = False in review_bot/config.py or logger level raised to WARNING via install_stderr_handler() prevents caplog from receiving downstream log records, causing assertions to pass without verifying anything

The void-assertion defect is order-dependent and non-deterministic under parallel test distribution (-n 6 --dist worksteal), so identical assertions verify coverage in isolation but verify nothing in a full suite run

Five negative caplog assertions across the test suite are vulnerable: they would pass vacuously if propagation/level were disabled, rendering coverage invisible and undetectable from a green run output

An autouse fixture guard in tests/_log_integrity.py must fail loudly and blame the source test when propagation is disabled mid-test or logger level is raised, restoring invariants at teardown and preventing cascade to downstream tests
